def solve_align_to_top(grid):
    # Find connected components

                        cells.append((cr, cc))
                min_r = min(c[0] for c in cells)
                shapes[color] = {'cells': cells, 'min_r': min_r}
    
    # Find the topmost shape (smallest min_row)
